priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head cfad9afd85d45830f9f7958c1739fbc1dda97109, src/socket.ts:3 returns an empty cleanup function immediately after registering handler with socket.on. The base implementation called socket.off("message", handler), so invoking the disposer still leaves the PR-added retained listener behavior in place.
